summary: Fixed-iteration heartbeat loop: steps an int pointer backwards by 6 elements (24 bytes) per iteration from dword_8CBF48 and calls an empty stub, 1024 times.

operations.description: Initialize pointer v0 to address of global dword_8CBF48.
do/while loop executing until counter v1 reaches zero.
Decrement pointer v0 by 6 int elements (24 bytes) each iteration.
Decrement loop counter v1 by 1 each iteration.

unresolved: Whether dword_8CBF48 anchors a stride-24 element array and what the backwards pointer walk covers is not established.
Why the per-iteration work is only an empty stub is unclear; the heartbeat likely replaced or degenerated from a real update step.
